Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and starting point. We prepare a day-by-day itinerary and a quotation, and revise both until they suit you. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

For schools, colleges and societies interested in other regions, such as Gujarat, Odisha, Varanasi and Sarnath, the Deccan or the south. The route is designed around what your group is studying, and an expert in that period accompanies you.

A day-by-day itinerary and a quotation are shared before you commit. Route, pace, accommodation and budget are adjusted to suit your group.

What it covers

  • A region you choose
  • A route built around what your group is studying
  • An expert in that period travelling with you
  • An itinerary and a quotation before you commit

How it is planned

  1. Tell us the region and the syllabus

    Where your group wants to go, what it is studying, how many days you have and how many of you there are.

  2. We propose a route and an expert

    A route built around the syllabus, with a specialist in the period or region.

  3. You receive an itinerary and a quotation

    Day by day, with what is included and what is not, revised until it suits you.

  4. You travel with the expert

    The specialist leads the group throughout, with reading sent in advance.
